name: Austriadraco
isnote: Recovered as a very basal pterosaur by Dalla Vecchia; Kellner placed it in its own family (Austriadraconidae). Relationships uncertain.
sum: Late Triassic (Norian) pterosaur from Tyrol, Austria, previously identified as Eudimorphodon.
holotype: BSP 1994 I 51 — Seefeld Formation (late Norian), Reither Spitze, Tyrol.
material: Partial, disarticulated skeleton with skull bones (frontals, jugal, lower jaws), vertebrae, shoulder girdle, humeri, pelvis and leg bones; partly impressions only.
biology: Small basal pterosaur; ecology not specifically studied.
author: Kellner 2015

species.name: Austriadraco dallavecchiai
species.author: Kellner 2015
